svg.title: Every arrival in the window is labelled
svg.desc: One 30 s window from a swarm holds the arrivals of two events. The metadata row of the trace describes only event 0. With label_events trace_event only event 0 gets P and S labels and the arrivals of event 1 are labelled noise. With all_events, the default, both events are labelled.
svg.text: event 1 labelled noise: the model learns to ignore it
default: every catalogued event at the station
